description: This file defines a Flutter widget named WeeklyForecastGrid, which displays a grid of weather forecast items (likely for a week). It constructs a grid layout with forecast details for each day, including icons, high/low temperatures, and day labels.

classes.name: WeeklyForecastGrid
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a 2x3 grid of daily weather forecast items.

methods.name: _iconFromName
methods.description: Maps weather icon names to Material Icons used in the forecast display.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the forecast grid, including layout, styling, and item rendering.
